cases.title: one-question workbook with existing styles
assertions: package is accepted without repair
all values are synthetic
source sheet identity is recorded by sheetId, relationship and name
new projection does not inherit formula, hyperlink or worksheet relationship
the output adds Eval, Evaluation_Config and Evaluation_Run without renaming either reserved control sheet
record-key values remain outside every Copilot payload DTO

cases.title: two-question workbook without a styles part
assertions: a valid source sheet not named Original is accepted
the minimum ADR-0003 styles part can be added without changing existing parts
typed values remain typed under the projection contract

cases.title: ten-question workbook with sparse rows and an Eval name collision
assertions: intermediate empty rows do not truncate the range
style-only trailing rows do not increase the data count
existing Eval is preserved
Eval (2) is used only after explicit confirmation

cases.title: preservation workbook with non-executable package features
assertions: all existing non-allowlist part payload hashes are unchanged
all existing URI, content type and relationship tuples are unchanged
projection omits table, filter, chart, image, custom XML and defined name

cases.title: local formula with a stored cached value
assertions: formula presence and cached-value limitations are shown before confirmation
only cached value 3 is projected and identified as an unverified source-workbook snapshot rather than an app-verified result
no CellFormula node is created in Eval

cases.title: local formula without a stored cached value
assertions: the application does not evaluate the formula
the execution confirmation cannot pass until the mapping is resolved
no CellFormula node is created in Eval

cases.title: input file size exactly at the accepted boundary
assertions: the inclusive 100 MiB boundary is accepted

cases.title: expanded package size exactly at the accepted boundary
assertions: the inclusive 1 GiB boundary is accepted

cases.title: ZIP entry count exactly at the accepted boundary
assertions: the inclusive 10000-entry boundary is accepted

cases.title: single expanded entry exactly at the accepted boundary
assertions: the inclusive 256 MiB boundary is accepted

cases.title: compression ratio exactly at the accepted boundary
assertions: the inclusive 100 to 1 boundary is accepted using exact integer operands

cases.title: used row count exactly at the accepted boundary
assertions: the inclusive 20000-row boundary is accepted

cases.title: used column count exactly at the accepted boundary
assertions: the inclusive 300-column boundary is accepted

cases.title: worksheet count exactly at the accepted boundary
assertions: the inclusive 40-sheet boundary is accepted

cases.title: shared string count exactly at the accepted boundary
assertions: the inclusive 2000000-shared-string boundary is accepted

cases.title: unique cell format count exactly at the accepted boundary
assertions: the inclusive 20000-format boundary is accepted

cases.title: cell character count exactly at the accepted boundary
assertions: the inclusive 32767-character boundary is accepted
